text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs that only manifested for records with non-ASCII names.","The root cause of the infinite recursion was the config loader reading the wrong environment file.","The fix made environment selection explicit and implemented fail-closed behavior on ambiguity.","The fix was submitted as PR #4325 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1.","The infinite recursion bug could be reproduced by walking a cyclic fixture graph.","The error rate dropped from 7.2% to under 0.08% after implementing the fix."]}
